title: A chat answer gets no receipt: lastAnswer on the item is the record (consultant's pick, not the owner's)
ruling: CONSULTANT'S PICK, NOT THE OWNER'S, 02:48 CST Nov 15, undoable (consultant, under the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words). No reader, no record: a chat answer gets no receipts/<id> doc; `lastAnswer` on the closed item is the record. The six writer-written receipts (items 849, 851, 852, 328, 861, 865) are deleted from the page; their full content is kept in roadmap/waiting/receipts-deleted-2026-11-15.json on this branch (commit 2f8d6eb21) and all six items stay closed with `lastAnswer` intact (read back 02:49 CST). Draft PR #3486 (the skill sentence that would have named the case) is closed with a pointer. Why: PR #3486's Sonnet round-1 review found nothing reads a receipt for a chat answer (page.html receipt() sets {} with no answers doc; lineReply and lineWhere drop receipts for a closed item; the 'Answered, filed in' badges need a saved answer; stale_pages.py --unread reads only answers docs), so the receipts were dead data and the skill sentence 'the page shows them on the answered card' was false for them. SUPERSEDES the consultant's (b) of 02:44 and (a) of 02:45 CST (both withdrawn at 02:48). The skill waiting-page receipts rule stays as written: the owning session writes receipts for page answers (answers/<id> exists); the writer never writes receipts. NOT COVERED: a page-saved answer's receipt (the owning session still writes it), any change to the page, a reader for receipts. Step writer-never-writes-receipts stays as a candidate guard. Reopens if the owner says otherwise.
quote: (b). No reader, no record: delete the six writer-written receipts, close #3486 with a one-line pointer, lastAnswer is the record for chat answers. My (b)/(a) at 02:44-02:45 are withdrawn. Keep step writer-never-writes-receipts.
source: Consultant 02:48 CST Nov 15 to triage (a pick, not the owner's words). Basis: Sonnet round-1 review of PR #3486 (finding 1: nothing reads the receipt).
